acceptance: Realtime streams handle interruption, reconnection, cancellation and process ownership without replaying unsafe writes.

positive.fixture: ordered output with replay of only what a reconnect missed, completed input stays acknowledged, only the exact owner reaches a process, clean cancel before input, exit code kept, high volume stays inside the buffer, idle processes swept

negative.fixture: input in flight at a drop is unknown and never sent again, a disconnect before any traffic leaves nothing unknown, a different source session fails closed, output older than the replay buffer is a gap, slow processes get backpressure, bad sequence numbers and oversize frames refused, per-owner limits

versions.schema: Go-only: Hub, Process, Owner, Conn, Dialer, StreamConfig, refusal reasons stream.*

security_and_source_permissions: A process is bound to tenant, caller and session; any other presenter gets a refusal that reveals nothing; a re-attach to another source session fails closed; input is at-most-once and an unknown fate is never retried.
performance_memory_storage: Replay, queued input, frame size and processes per owner are bounded by configuration; a 300 ms high-volume test keeps memory within the replay buffer.
known_limitations: Hub is tested with in-memory dialers and is not yet exposed through the HTTP or MCP interfaces
